title: The freshness benchmark's p95 uses round(), which rounds half to even, so the rank is one low for some sample sizes
goal: bench_retrieval's freshness p95 takes the nearest-rank percentile, math.ceil(0.95 * n), so n=30 gives rank 29, not 28; the repro exits 0 once the code no longer rounds with round(). SP-etslk6yu review; the recorded n=44 run is unaffected.

run: import sys; sys.exit(1 if 'int(round(0.95 * len(walls)))' in open('_tools/bench_retrieval.py', encoding='utf-8').read() else 0)

repro_reason: the percentile is computed inline in fresh_rows over live wall times; a fixture run needs a refactor the fix makes
